name: Sweetwater River Crossing
description: Flowing river in northern Great Divide Basin. Reliable filterable water source before long arid stretches.

name: Oregon Buttes Spring & Historic Monument
description: Natural spring and historic pioneer waypoint beneath Oregon Buttes. Filter required.

name: Dianthus Well & Solar Stock Pump
description: BLM solar-powered deep well and stock tank in central Great Divide Basin. Critical lifeline water source.

name: A&M Reservoir & Spillway Creek
description: Critical Great Divide Basin reservoir. Filter water from the spillway overflow creek rather than the stagnant main body.

name: Battle Spring Drainage
description: Seasonal spring drainage in southern Great Divide Basin, ~19 miles north of Wamsutter resupply.

name: Mesa Alta Spring & Water Catchment
description: Spring catchment in Santa Fe National Forest high badlands between Abiquiu and Cuba. Must filter.

name: San Mateo Basin Spring
description: Natural spring in northern Mount Taylor volcanic foothills. Filter required.

name: Pie Town Toaster House Water Spigot
description: Legendary hiker/biker sanctuary in Pie Town. Reliable outdoor potable water spigot.

name: Beaverhead Work Center Spigot
description: USFS Beaverhead Ranger Station in central Gila National Forest. Potable water spigot outside.

name: Sapillo Creek / Highway 35 Crossing
description: Perennial mountain stream crossing in southern Gila near Lake Roberts. Filter required.

name: Separ Continental Divide Water Oasis
description: Critical desert water stop at I-10 crossing between Silver City and Hachita.

name: Hachita Community Water Spigot
description: Community water spigot in Hachita. Last potable water source before 45-mile desert run to the Mexican border.

name: Antelope Wells Border Station Water
description: Finish terminus of the Tour Divide at Mexico border. Potable water available at US Port of Entry building.
